facts.question: Who won Artist of the Year at the 2024 MAMA Awards?
facts.fun_fact: NewJeans won the award in 2023 and Seventeen followed in 2024.

facts.question: Which artist won MAMA Artist of the Year every year from 2016 to 2022?
facts.fun_fact: BTS took Artist of the Year seven years in a row, from 2016 to 2022.

facts.question: Which song won Song of the Year at the 2022 MAMA Awards?
facts.fun_fact: IVE won with Love Dive in 2022, NewJeans with Ditto in 2023 and aespa with Supernova in 2024.

facts.question: Which album won Album of the Year at the 2022 MAMA Awards?
facts.fun_fact: Proof by BTS won in 2022, after Be in 2021 and Map of the Soul: 7 in 2020.

facts.question: Which album won Album of the Year at the 2025 MAMA Awards?
facts.fun_fact: Stray Kids won Album of the Year in 2025 with Karma.

facts.question: Where are the 2026 MAMA Awards held?
facts.fun_fact: CJ ENM announced two days in Osaka, Japan, on November 20 and 21, 2026.

facts.question: In which year was the MAMA Awards first launched, according to CJ ENM?
facts.fun_fact: CJ ENM describes the first ceremony in 1999 as Korea's first music video ceremony.

facts.question: Which CJ ENM music channel first launched the MAMA Awards?
facts.fun_fact: Mnet launched the ceremony in 1999. Mnet Plus is the service that streams it live worldwide today.

facts.question: In which year did the MAMA Awards take place in the United States for the first time?
facts.fun_fact: CJ ENM calls the 2024 edition in the United States a historic milestone.

facts.question: Which service streams the 2026 MAMA Awards live worldwide, according to CJ ENM?
facts.fun_fact: The 2026 edition carries the message Music Makes ONE.
